title: SKF_SETUP_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-setup displays when {headless_mode} or {quiet_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_SETUP_RESULT_JSON: '. Step 4 builds it at the end of a run (status success or tier_failure); a halt that names a phase builds a blocked one with the helper's emit-blocked subcommand. Pipelines grep one line out of the workflow log without parsing ASCII-art and without racing the forge-tier.yaml writer.

status.description: Single-field outcome for pipeline branching. 'success' when the run finished with no error and any required tier is satisfied. 'tier_failure' when --require-tier was set and is not satisfied. 'blocked' for any halt that still produced an envelope; error.phase names it, for example 'step 2:write-tools', 'step 2:init-prefs' or 'step 2:forge-data-dir' when forge-tier.yaml, preferences.yaml or the forge data folder could not be written.

tier.description: Active capability tier this run. A blocked envelope carries 'Quick' as a placeholder.

previous_tier.description: Tier read from the existing forge-tier.yaml at workflow start. Null on first runs.

tier_changed.description: True when previous_tier is non-null AND differs from tier. False on first runs and same-tier re-runs. Lets pipelines react to upgrades without re-reading forge-tier.yaml.

tools_added.description: Tool keys with available=true that were NOT available in previous_tools. On first runs, equals the currently-detected tools.

tools_removed.description: Tool keys that were available in previous_tools but are NOT available now.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the forge-tier.yaml this run wrote. A blocked envelope carries error.path here, or '<unknown — halt before config_path resolved>' when the halt has no path.

files_written.description: Files written this run, as step 4 reports them. A blocked envelope always carries an empty array, even when an earlier step had already written a file.

tier_override_active.description: True when a valid tier_override from preferences.yaml was applied.

tier_override_invalid.description: True when tier_override was set but did not match Quick|Forge|Forge+|Deep (case-sensitive). Detected tier was used as fallback.

require_tier_satisfied.description: Null when --require-tier was not set. Otherwise true if the tool prerequisites of the requested tier are met (Deep does NOT subsume Forge+).

warnings.description: Non-fatal anomalies surfaced during the run. May include tier_override_invalid, tier_override_unsafe, ccc_exclusion_warnings entries, ccc_registry_stale_removed entries, qmd_daemon_stopped, ccc_indexing_failed, etc. Empty when none.

phase.description: The halt that produced the envelope, as <step>:<cause> (e.g. 'step 2:write-tools', 'on-activation:uv-missing').

path.description: Absolute path of the file or folder the halt concerns, or '<n/a>' when it has none.

error.description: Null unless a halt produced the envelope; then the halt's phase, path and diagnostic. status is 'blocked' exactly when error is non-null, and the other fields of a blocked envelope are placeholders.
